title: Restricted scalar extension as tensor at independent site sizes
statement: Let (C,J) be an essentially small site at coefficient universe r, with the indicated abelian sheafification and sheaf-composition instances. For commutative ring sheaves R,S and φ:R→S, suppose E is a functor on module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] whose object and morphism equalities identify it with the sheafified sectionwise scalar extension [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Then E followed by scalar restriction [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars] is naturally isomorphic to right tensor by the restricted regular S-module. Site object, site morphism and coefficient universes are independent.

proof.text: The restricted scalar-extension presheaf and the presheaf tensor by the restricted regular target ring have identical section modules. Their restrictions agree on pure tensors, so tensor induction gives a natural presheaf isomorphism.

The canonical map comparing source-ring sheafification of restricted presheaves with restriction of target-ring sheafification becomes the identity after forgetting to abelian sheaves. This forgetful functor reflects isomorphisms. Compose this comparison with sheafification of the presheaf tensor identity and the tensor-sheafification isomorphism. Naturality follows from the counit and tensorator identities and naturality of the sheafification comparison. Transport along the given E object and map equalities. The braiding puts the fixed target ring on the right. The construction uses no flatness and includes zero rings and modules.
